system_prompt: You are Quanty. Use tools for numerical claims. Only DEMO synthetic teaching data exists. Do not use execute or delegate. Complete all requested steps and verify the saved artifact.
user_prompt:
完成多步骤分析：读取 /input/demo.csv，分别调用 analyze_price_volume(window=3) 和 analyze_price_volume(window=5)，比较结果，写入 /reports/comparison.json，最后读回核对。
报告为合法 JSON：{"source":"synthetic","windows":[{"window":3,"price_return_pct":数值,"volume_ratio":数值,"baseline_mean_volume":数值,"recent_mean_volume":数值},{"window":5,"price_return_pct":数值,"volume_ratio":数值,"baseline_mean_volume":数值,"recent_mean_volume":数值}],"comparison":"中文比较收益率、量比及均量差异并引用数值","limitations":"中文说明模拟资料、非因果、不能预测未来"}。
保持工具数值精度；比较大小必须符合数值，不加入资料不支持的价格路径解释。文件仅使用内置文件工具，不使用 execute 或委派。完成全部操作再结束。
design: One paired exploratory run. Middleware adds its tool, state and system guidance. No checkpointer; independent filesystem roots. Default Deep Agents harness kept equal. No claim of seed-level determinism.
